Subject: Vendor master setup — LarkTech (legal entity and PO routing)

Hi Susan —

Thanks again for the demo last week. We're ready to kick off vendor master creation so our procurement and AP teams can issue purchase orders and process invoices. To get the record created cleanly, can you please confirm/provide the following items? If any are sensitive, feel free to share via the secure upload link in the HubSpot record (link below).

Required items for vendor master:
- Legal entity name (as filed)
- Tax ID / EIN (or VAT number for non-US entities)
- W-9 or other tax form (if US)
- Primary remit-to address (street, city, state, ZIP)
- Invoice recipient name and email (who should receive POs and AP correspondence)
- PO contact (name, email, phone)
- Bank wiring details or ACH remit instructions (bank name, account name, routing/IBAN)
- Authorized signer for contracts (name, title, email)

Optional but helpful:
- Beneficial ownership attestation or KYC packet (if available)
- Preferred PO reference format (e.g., project code included)

Next steps: once we have the items above we'll create the vendor master and route a test PO. If finance needs a different remittance path, we'll surface that in the confirmation.

Secure upload: https://redwoodinference.sharepoint.com/sites/procurement/VendorForms/LarkTech
HubSpot company: https://app.hubspot.com/records/companies/123456789

Appreciate a reply by end of day Wednesday if possible so we can align kickoff.

Thanks,
Naomi Feldman
